reviewed_version: Undated 36-page author PDF, exact acquired snapshot
summary: Two peripheral false scope statements, two invalid core derivations, and a printed covariance certificate defect with exact verified repair. Bilocal bound independently confirmed.

problems.title: Almost-everywhere positivity does not imply independent-point positivity
problems.source_claim: Universal random-variable a.e. positivity is equivalent to positivity for all independent (mu,X) in Kbold x K.
problems.complete_check: Only admissible measure is delta_0; all admissible F=0 a.e., so random-variable condition holds. At (delta_0,1), f=-1.
problems.counterevidence: No full support assumption; pure-moment f would not exhibit this failure. Pointwise main theorem and pure-moment Bell applications are not refuted.
problems.impact: False scope bridge; no demonstrated failure of main archimedean theorem or Bell applications.

correction.statement: Replace independent X in K by X in supp(mu). Continuity gives a.e. iff support-wise positivity; pushforward gives RV equivalence.

problems.title: Boundedness does not imply archimedeanness for the stated arbitrary constraint set
problems.source_claim: Bounded K(S1) implies f+epsilon belongs to moment cone of square-free products for every epsilon>0.
problems.complete_check: K={0}, so f=0 on feasible set. Any certificate uses finitely many j; choose R^2>max(1,used j). Every term evaluates nonnegatively at (delta_R,R), while 1-m2=1-R^2<0.
problems.counterevidence: Finite-S1 interpretation excludes example but is not stated. Test pair need only satisfy used generators of a finite identity.
problems.impact: False bounded-set corollary for infinite presentation; finite SDP applications and Theorem 4.2 with actual archimedean premise survive.

correction.statement: Adjoin a valid ball constraint; Theorem 4.2 then applies to enlarged cone, not original cone.

problems.title: Empty-set construction does not yield the required nonnegative polynomial
problems.source_claim: With S1'=z({1} U S1), S2'=m_first^2 S2, zf is nonnegative on the new feasible set.
problems.complete_check: New S1'={z}, S2'={-m_(1,0)^2}. nu=delta_(0,1) and X=(0,1) satisfy all new constraints but (zf)(nu,X)=-1.
problems.counterevidence: Original theorem conclusion actually true in this test case since -1 is an original cone generator. Switching to RV interpretation does not rescue the failed step.
problems.impact: Invalid reduction in core perturbative Positivstellensatz for empty feasible sets; no theorem-conclusion counterexample.

correction.remaining: New support and moment-constraint argument for empty-feasible-set case.

problems.title: Zero-moment homomorphism does not map the moment cone to the ordinary cone
problems.source_claim: The homomorphism fixing x and sending nonconstant moments to zero maps QM(S,empty) into QM(S).
problems.complete_check: m(x^2-1)=m2-1 is moment-cone generator. Its image is -1, which cannot belong to ordinary QM(S) because evaluation at feasible x=1 is nonnegative on that cone.
problems.counterevidence: Correcting theorem-number citation alone cannot fix the generator failure; statement of corollary not disproved.
problems.impact: Invalid derivation of advertised general classical constrained-polynomial extension.

correction.statement: For nonempty K, moment evaluation at feasible delta_a preserves the cone.
correction.remaining: Perturbation constants and empty K require further proof; no complete repair claimed.

problems.title: Printed covariance vector fails its exact certificate identity
problems.source_claim: m(v^T G v)=9/2-f modulo x_j^2=1 using mixed moment m110000 in entries 1,7,8.
problems.complete_check: All moments=1 and f=0. Printed v=(1,0,5,-10,0,1,38/3,38/3), yielding 7/2 rather than 9/2. General discrepancy factors as in exact_checks.stdout.json.
problems.counterevidence: Inequality itself not refuted. Archived certificate notebook uses first-moment sum in the three entries and exact independent expansion confirms repaired identity.
problems.impact: False printed central exact certificate for covariance conjecture, despite valid repaired upper bound.

correction.statement: Replace m110000 in entries 1,7,8 by m100000+m010000; unchanged G has all eight leading principal minors positive and residual identically zero.
correction.provenance: Repair expression already present in acquired repository commit; no author code execution or experiment provenance inferred.
